title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented Butler-specific traditions and recurring practices, with historical items clearly distinguished from current programming.

cards.title: Yell Like Hell in Hinkle
cards.subtitle: Homecoming performance tradition
cards.notes: Attend through the official Homecoming program and watch the rehearsed teams perform Butler-themed routines.
cards.short_summary: A Butler Homecoming performance contest staged in Hinkle Fieldhouse.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler documents Yell Like Hell as an annual Homecoming tradition celebrated by students in Hinkle Fieldhouse.
cards.access_notes: Participate only through current official Homecoming programming and venue rules.

cards.title: Watch the Hampton Drive Chariots
cards.subtitle: Homecoming morning tradition
cards.notes: Spectate from the official viewing area and stay outside the race route, barricades, and participant zone.
cards.short_summary: A fraternity-hosted Homecoming race down Hampton Drive.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler documents the Sigma Chi-hosted chariot race down Hampton Drive as an annual Homecoming tradition.
cards.access_notes: Attend only if included in the current official schedule; remain in designated spectator areas.

cards.title: Join Bulldog Boulevard
cards.subtitle: Homecoming pregame gathering
cards.notes: Use official booths for food, games, and club information; follow current event and stadium-entry policies.
cards.short_summary: A Butler Homecoming gathering of colleges, clubs, alumni, and students.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler describes Bulldog Boulevard as a Homecoming tailgate with organization booths, food, games, and spirit cheers.
cards.access_notes: Current location, admission, and activities depend on the official Homecoming schedule.

cards.title: Line the Dawg Walk Route
cards.subtitle: Homecoming route to Sellick Bowl
cards.notes: Check the current route and stand in the designated public area without blocking team or event operations.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled Butler Homecoming procession toward Sellick Bowl.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler’s official Homecoming schedule lists the Dawg Walk from Robertson Hall to Sellick Bowl.
cards.access_notes: Use the current Homecoming schedule for timing, route, and any access restrictions.

cards.title: Meet the Homecoming Bulldogs
cards.subtitle: Annual Bulldog Beauty Contest
cards.notes: Attend as a spectator or register a dog through the official process; follow animal and event requirements.
cards.short_summary: A Butler Homecoming contest devoted specifically to bulldogs.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler’s Homecoming page lists the annual Butler Bulldog Beauty Contest as a free Homecoming favorite.
cards.access_notes: Spectator event is listed free; animal participation requires official registration and compliance.

cards.title: Serve Through BITS
cards.subtitle: Butler community service tradition
cards.notes: Register when the program opens, follow the partner organization’s briefing, and complete the assigned service.
cards.short_summary: A Butler-wide day of service learning for new students and the community.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler calls BITS a tradition of serving together involving students, faculty, staff, and the wider community.
cards.access_notes: Program dates and registration vary; follow the current service-site requirements.

cards.title: Greet Butler Blue IV
cards.subtitle: Official live-mascot tradition
cards.notes: Meet Blue only at an announced appearance, give the handler space, and ask before approaching or touching.
cards.short_summary: Butler’s official English bulldog mascot program, established in 2000.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler documents its official live English bulldog mascot program and identifies Blue IV as the current mascot.
cards.access_notes: Appearances are scheduled; interaction is controlled by the mascot handler and event rules.

cards.title: Learn the Cheers in Hinkle
cards.subtitle: New-student orientation tradition
cards.notes: Attend the scheduled orientation session to learn cheers and the fight song with Butler spirit groups.
cards.short_summary: A new-student introduction to Butler athletics and spirit inside Hinkle.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler’s 2026 orientation schedule lists Hinkle Magic with cheerleaders, dance team, pep band, coaches, cheers, and fight song.
cards.access_notes: An orientation program for new students; follow the assigned schedule and venue instructions.

cards.title: Build a Sundae, Find a Community
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week tradition
cards.notes: Join the scheduled social, make a sundae, and speak with campus religious and meaning-making communities.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Butler welcome event linking ice cream and community connections.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler calls the Compass Center Ice Cream Social a favorite Welcome Week tradition for new students.
cards.access_notes: For students participating in Welcome Week; use the current orientation schedule.

cards.title: Take the Rave-Yard Shift
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week nighttime program
cards.notes: Follow the official event footprint for dancing, games, astronomy, crafts, and supervised firepit activities.
cards.short_summary: A Butler new-student night combining Atherton Mall and the observatory.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler’s orientation schedule documents Rave-Yard Shift at Atherton Union, Atherton Mall, and Holcomb Observatory.
cards.access_notes: New-student orientation event; participate only during scheduled, supervised programming.
